text:
nina: Kickoff: onboarding wave for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Need SKU rules, trial copy, and telemetry mapping by end of sprint. I uploaded a short checklist: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/mini-kickoff

samir: For SKUs propose parsable pattern: `redwood-<cloud>-<product>-<tier>-<region>-<flag>`. Keeps scripts simple. Example: redwood-gcp-inference-pro-europe-west1-trial.

elaine-legal: If "trial" appears we must surface trial length and auto-renew behavior in the offer metadata. Also need DPA link and EULA anchor. I can draft the minimal language once SKU list is live.

jay-eng: Telemetry: emit `marketplace.purchase` events with keys: sku, offer_id, plan, customer_hash, meter_code. Add header `X-RW-Trace` for cross-system tracing. We'll map meter_code -> [tokens, embeddings, sessions].

alex-ops: I'll create a sandbox publisher account for E2E tests in staging and give Samir access. Azure specific: you need a Service Principal + MarketplacePublisher role. I'll add role snippet to the doc.

release-bot: release scheduled: marketplace/sandbox-setup -> staging at 2024-11-14T02:00:00Z

nina: Plan: Samir -> AWS SKUs, Jay+Alex -> telemetry + smoke tests, Elaine -> legal text. Target staging canary next Tue. I'll update doc with owner table tonight. Thanks.
